pins.head: A LOW RACK CATCHES THE SHOES
pins.title: Small Entryway: A Low Shoe Rack Beside the Door Ends the Pile
pins.desc: Shoes pile up wherever they come off, so put a low open rack exactly there and the pile has somewhere to go. Pair it with a narrow table for keys and mail and the first metre inside the door stops being a drop zone. Nothing here goes into the wall, so it all leaves with you. Contains affiliate links. #EntrywayIdeas #ShoeStorage #RenterFriendly
pins.alt: A wooden coat stand with a coat and tote bag, a low shoe rack with boots and sneakers beside a slim console table, and a coat hanging on the front door of a bright entryway with a patterned rug.

pins.head: DECANT, DO NOT REPLACE
pins.sub: Keep the Jar, Buy the Pouch
pins.title: Moisturizer Refills: Keep One Good Jar and Decant From a Pouch
pins.desc: The jar is the part you pay for and the part that lasts. Keep one you like on the counter, buy the same formula in a refill pouch, and decant a few weeks at a time. You stop paying for a new container with every tub and the counter stays exactly as tidy as it is now. Contains affiliate links. #SkincareRoutine #RefillNotReplace #BathroomCounter
pins.alt: A refill pouch standing on a white bathroom counter beside a small open glass jar of cream, with a bright window behind.

pins.head: THE SHOWER DOOR TAKES A CADDY
pins.sub: Hang It, Leave the Tile Alone
pins.title: Small Bathroom: Hang a Caddy on the Shower Door Instead of the Tile
pins.desc: A caddy that hooks over the shower door or stands in the corner holds everything a drilled shelf would, and it comes down in a minute when you move out. Pick one with drainage holes and a rust-resistant finish so it is not the thing you end up replacing. Contains affiliate links. #BathroomStorage #ShowerCaddy #NoDrill
pins.alt: A white toilet beneath a shelf unit of rolled towels and baskets, a wicker basket on the floor, a teal towel on a hook and a glass shower door with a caddy of bottles inside.

pins.head: HOT GLUE IS NOT FOR EVERYTHING
pins.sub: Gun, Liquid or Tape by Material
pins.title: Craft Adhesives: When Hot Glue Works and When to Reach for Something Else
pins.desc: Hot glue is fast and strong on wood, card and fabric, and useless on thin plastic it melts or smooth surfaces it peels off overnight. Keep a liquid craft glue for paper and a tape for anything you might want to move, and the gun stops being the answer to every job. Contains affiliate links. #CraftGlue #HotGlueGun #DIYCrafts
pins.alt: A cream hot glue gun on a wooden stand with glue sticks beside it, a squeeze bottle of craft glue and a roll of masking tape on a wooden workbench under a window.

pins.head: RUB IT DOWN BEFORE YOU PEEL
pins.title: Felt Vinyl Squeegee for Burnishing Decals Before the Tape Comes Off
pins.desc: Most lifted letters are not a tape problem, they are a burnishing problem. A felt-edged squeegee presses the vinyl onto the surface without scratching it, and a second pass after the tape is off seals the edges. Two in the pack means one stays clean for finished work. Contains affiliate links. #VinylDecals #CricutTips #CraftTools
pins.alt: A sheet of clear transfer tape being lifted from a green cutting mat that holds a copper leaf decal, with two felt squeegees resting on the tape.

pins.head: FILES UP, BASKET DOWN
pins.title: Small Home Office: Stand the Files Up and Put a Basket Underneath
pins.desc: A desk this size has no room for piles, so paper goes vertical in a sorter and everything that is not today's work goes in a basket on the floor beneath it. The surface you can see is the surface you work on, and the basket is one lift to put away. Contains affiliate links. #HomeOffice #DeskOrganization #SmallSpaceLiving
pins.alt: A light wood desk with a row of file folders standing in a sorter, a small drawer organizer and a laptop raised on a wooden stand, with a wicker basket on the floor under the desk and a teal chair.

pins.head: A BLOCK KEEPS BRUSHES APART
pins.title: Brush Care: A Holder Block Keeps Bristles Straight Between Sessions
pins.desc: Brushes tossed in a cup lean on each other and set with a bend. A block with a hole per brush keeps every tip straight and lets the ferrules dry apart, and it makes the end-of-session reset a thirty-second job: rinse, blot on the cloth, drop each one in its hole. Contains affiliate links. #PaintBrushCare #AcrylicPainting #ArtStudio
pins.alt: A wooden block holder with a row of paint brushes standing bristles up in it, on a wooden table by a bright window.

pins.head: NO CLOSET, HANG A RACK
pins.title: Small Bedroom Without a Closet: A Freestanding Rack Does the Job
pins.desc: A bedroom with no closet needs a rail, not a wardrobe you cannot get through the door. A freestanding rack takes the clothes you wear this season, baskets underneath take the rest, and the whole thing moves when the furniture does. Contains affiliate links. #SmallBedroom #ClothesRack #NoCloset
pins.alt: A bed with a teal duvet and a clear storage bin pulled out from underneath, a small nightstand with a lamp, and a black clothes rack with shirts on hangers and baskets below.

pins.head: CHECK THE PANEL, NOT THE CLAIM
pins.title: Supplement Labels: What the Facts Panel Tells You That the Front Does Not
pins.desc: The front of the bottle is marketing. The panel on the back lists the serving size, the amount per serving and the other ingredients, and that is where a cheap bottle and a dear one start to look different. Write down what you are comparing before you open the next tab. Contains affiliate links. #SupplementGuide #ReadTheLabel #HealthyHabits
pins.alt: Three amber supplement bottles on a wooden kitchen counter beside a notepad and pencil and a glass of water, with a sink and plants behind.

pins.head: LEAN IT AND LOAD IT
pins.title: Renter Storage: A Leaning Ladder Shelf Holds a Wall's Worth Without Anchors
pins.desc: A ladder shelf rests on the floor and the wall and asks nothing of either. It takes books, baskets and plants up the height of the room, stands on a rug without wobbling, and when the lease ends it folds flat and leaves no mark behind it. Contains affiliate links. #RenterFriendly #LadderShelf #SmallSpaceStorage
pins.alt: A wooden ladder shelf with books and baskets leaning against the wall, white shelves of plants by the window, and a grey sofa with cushions and an ottoman.

pins.head: CUPS PER WEEK SETS THE BAG
pins.title: Whole Bean Medium Roast, 30 oz, for a Coffee Order That Matches Your Week
pins.desc: Count the cups you actually make in a week and the right bag size falls out of the arithmetic. A 30 oz bag of whole beans covers a two-cup household for about a month, which is also how long beans stay fresh, so set the subscription to that and stop guessing. Contains affiliate links. #CoffeeAtHome #WholeBeanCoffee #PantryPlanning
pins.alt: Two plain kraft paper coffee bags on a wooden kitchen counter with scattered coffee beans and a small blank desk calendar, with a window behind.

pins.head: OPEN SHELVES SHOW THE PLATES
pins.sub: Hutch, Hooks and a Clear Counter
pins.title: Small Kitchen: Put the Everyday Plates on Open Shelves and Keep the Counter Clear
pins.desc: The plates you use every day do not need a cabinet door in front of them. An open hutch keeps them in reach and off the counter, hooks beside it take the towel and the shopping bag, and the one stretch of worktop you have stays free for cooking. Contains affiliate links. #SmallKitchen #OpenShelving #KitchenOrganization
pins.alt: A compact kitchen with a teal open hutch of plates and mugs, a towel and mesh bag hanging from wall hooks, a white stove with a red pot and an open fridge door on the right.
